name: prompt-617
image_purpose: Create a social-media-ready four-panel evening fashion collage.

prompt.project_info: UGC night-out outdoor-urban 2x2 fashion lifestyle collage.
prompt.main_subject: The same original adult woman appears in all four panels, with glamorous waves, evening makeup and a red lip. She wears a black satin slip dress, a leather jacket draped over her shoulders, strappy heels, a sparkly clutch and earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Cohesive 2x2 grid of four equal frames: top-left full-body flash pose against a metallic door or shutter; top-right over-the-shoulder walk toward neon city lights; bottom-left seated profile on a high bar stool or velvet booth holding a mocktail and laughing candidly; bottom-right artistic portrait near a neon sign, looking dreamily upward. Use a city-at-night or rooftop-bar setting with neon signs, city bokeh and dark shadows.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Mixed camera flash and vibrant pink/blue neon. Cool white flash creates high contrast while colored signs add cinematic party reflections and an edgy night-luxe atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Flash-photography and film-aesthetic look, 8K detail, slight grain, cohesive 2x2 grid, 4:5 overall aspect ratio. Evening wear can be swapped for a sequin dress or jumpsuit; dress silhouette is the product-placement area.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cohesive 2x2 four-panel fashion lifestyle collage featuring the same original adult woman in a glamorous evening outfit under city lights. She has glamorous waves, an evening makeup look with red lip, and wears a black satin slip dress, leather jacket draped over her shoulders, strappy heels, sparkly clutch and earrings. Top-left: full-body flash shot against a metallic door or shutter with one leg forward and a fierce expression. Top-right: over-the-shoulder view while walking toward neon city lights. Bottom-left: seated profile on a high bar stool or velvet booth holding a mocktail and laughing candidly. Bottom-right: artistic portrait near a neon sign with pink and blue light, looking dreamily upward. City-at-night or rooftop-bar setting, neon signs, city bokeh, dark shadows, mixed cool camera flash and vibrant neon, high-contrast edgy night-luxe party mood, slight film grain, 8K detail, 4:5 overall layout.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, real-person likeness, celebrity resemblance, unreadable text, logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, duplicate panels, inconsistent identity

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Adapt from the existing text prompt and folder/file naming only. Keep the same original adult subject consistent across all four panels; evening wear, makeup, mocktail, signs and venue details remain replaceable. A brand may optionally replace the evening-wear category or dress silhouette with its own approved product.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult while preserving the fashion collage concept.
Removed generic user-instruction syntax and converted it into retrieval-ready replacement guidance.
Added standard safety and anti-artifact exclusions.
